accepted_rules: schema v1 is restricted to synthetic fixtures
every non-synthetic dataset requires schema v2 governance
allowed evaluation uses and authorized roles use closed enumerations
retention date and deterministic deletion procedure are mandatory
redistributable agrees with the redistribution policy
public media licensing is rejected as authority for biometric ground truth
biometric ground truth requires prohibited redistribution, a privacy review reference and privacy-reviewer role
written authorization requires an opaque authority reference
face verification and clustering items require opaque identity IDs
limitations: the checked-in face manifest is a placeholder template, not an authorization or privacy approval
no real face images, consent records or identity ground truth were used
the validator cannot determine whether an opaque reference points to a genuine signed record
controlled storage, access audit and deletion rehearsal remain unproven
INT-005B, INT-007B, INT-015 and INT-S0 remain open
